recentItems.title: Elmo Makes a Bat House with Cookie Monster and The Count! 🦇 | Sesame Street & LEGO Little Ones
recentItems.description:
Bats help our plants grow strong through pollination, so let’s learn how we can help them! Watch Elmo, The Count, and Cookie Monster use bricks and arts and crafts to build a pretend home for their bat friends.

Use your creativity to build your own pretend bat house at http://www.LEGO.com/buildthechangewithsesame. This activity is part of the LEGO Group’s Build the Change social impact program, which encourages children to use creativity to tackle real-world challenges.
